component_exact_unit_additions.reason: Code:X directly supplies the Canadian Leopard 2A4M wrapper alongside Leopard C2 MEXAS. Omitting it left the Canadian national armor progression artificially incomplete.

France is intentionally a national hybrid using ARF line infantry until dedicated French line-infantry wrappers exist. The common-infantry research selector did not retain canonical purchase IDs carrying the (nato) suffix, leaving France with support weapons and vehicles but no recruitable line infantry.

actor_component_removals.reason: The complete Soviet legacy pool was too broad for Finland. Finland retains its directly source-backed T-55M, CV9030, Leopard 2A4 seed, NATO-common infantry, and NATO-common support without inheriting the entire Soviet roster.

can: Second self-audit added the directly source-backed Canadian Leopard 2A4M progression.
fin: Second self-audit removed the broad Soviet legacy pool; only directly selected Finnish/Nordic equipment and NATO-common gap filling remain.
fra: Native France acceptance restored the canonical ARF rifle, SPIKE, machine-gun, anti-tank, scout, and DSK engineer squads required by the temporary line-infantry policy.
